runners_data.name: Latin Five

runners_data.name: Soul Seeker
runners_data.note: Key front runner returning to lowest grade in years after a winless 2025 campaign
runners_data.comment: Had poor year in 2025; down in weights as a result but no great record after an absence
runners_data.spotlight: Regressed sharply in 2025, his first blank campaign since 2020; he has dropped a long way in the weights as a result and he now tackles his first 0-55 on grass; whether first time out is the time to catch him is a moot point too.

runners_data.name: Sir Benedict
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in good form with a useful 7lb claimer taking the ride

runners_data.name: Jamie's Choice
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning after exactly the same 204-day break as when finishing second in this race last year
runners_data.comment: Struggled after finishing second in this race in 2025; 7lb lower this time around
runners_data.spotlight: Won two classified events over 5f on turf in 2024; she finished a close second in the corresponding race 12 months ago (after an identical 204-day absence) but that was her only bright spot last year; 7lb lower this time around and she can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Running Cool
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carries warning signs about fading in the finish
runners_data.comment: Should be well handicapped but he has been disappointing so far in 2026
runners_data.spotlight: Good second at Wolverhampton on his stable debut last September; well short of that level in three runs this year, including when tried in cheekpieces 19 days ago; risky.

runners_data.name: Golden Prosperity
runners_data.note: Prominent tactics suit the likely pace scenario and has winning course form
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; returns to turf off a fair mark; well drawn and he is one to take seriously
runners_data.spotlight: Three of his four wins have come in classified company but the other was a C&D handicap; this mark in range judged on last season's best efforts and he is high on the list from a handy draw.

runners_data.name: Beneficiary
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical difficulty, also struggles on turf with five unplaced runs
runners_data.comment: Good chance if converting AW form to turf but hasn't managed that in five attempts before
runners_data.spotlight: Three times a runner-up on AW this year; unplaced in five turf runs and he comes here with a point to prove.

runners_data.name: Tommytwohoots
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent course record including two seconds in this very race
runners_data.comment: Twice second in the corresponding race; unraced on faster than good to soft
runners_data.spotlight: Finished second in this race in 2023 (soft) and 2024 (heavy); good second at Wolverhampton on his stable debut (6f) two weeks ago; well drawn back on turf but his 18 turf runs have seen him steer clear of anything faster than good to soft.

runners_data.name: Doralee
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but others appear stronger at current levels
runners_data.comment: Only win came in classified company; sharper for last month's return; others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Gained her only win from 16 attempts in a 5f classified event at Redcar last August; shaped as though the run was needed on her AW return last month; others appeal more for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Baby Rover
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning after a 190-day absence with best form at longer trips
runners_data.comment: Her one win and most of her best runs have come over 6f; best watched after 190 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 6f handicap at Redcar last summer; runner-up twice afterwards but she has been absent since a low-key run at Newcastle 190 days ago; best form has come at 6f.

runners_data.name: Siviez
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner dropping to 5f for the first time with only modest form over further
runners_data.comment: Poor form over 7f and 1m; drops in trip with a point to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Five runs, all over further, and she has run to just a modest level; drops to 5f with a point to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Soul Seeker will take this field along as the only confirmed front runner, likely getting an uncontested lead through the early stages. With most runners preferring prominent or hold-up tactics, the pace will be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing Soul Seeker to dictate terms without immediate pressure. The combination of one clear leader and a moderate gallop sets up perfectly for horses that can travel prominently and sustain their effort, while hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground on good ground over this sharp 5f trip. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker sets a steady pace without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows prominent runners like Golden Prosperity and Tommytwohoots to travel smoothly in behind before unleashing finishing kicks. Hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the change of gear on good ground over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes surprisingly strong with multiple horses challenging Soul Seeker early
scenarios.body: A faster pace sets up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to finish strongly as the early leaders tire. Sir Benedict and Latin Five can use their closing kicks to maximum effect in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The veteran front runner uses his tactical advantage to build an unassailable lead, with the field leaving their challenges too late. His dropping handicap mark finally pays dividends in this weak grade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the returning horses Jamie's Choice or Baby Rover prove significantly fresher than their layoffs suggest
scenarios.body: Both mares have shown ability at this level previously and could exploit any tactical mistakes from more fancied rivals. Their freshness after long breaks becomes a decisive advantage rather than a hindrance.

watchPoints.text: Watch Soul Seeker's early fractions - if allowed completely uncontested lead he could prove very difficult to peg back
Monitor how Latin Five handles the wide draw from stall 12 as it could force him wider than ideal for his hold-up style
Running Cool and Siviez both carry finishing warnings - expect them to fade if in contention approaching the final furlong
Watch the market for Jamie's Choice and Baby Rover as any confidence could signal their long absences have freshened them significantly
Keep an eye on the pace battle between Soul Seeker and any prominent runners who might press him early and compromise the moderate gallop scenario

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap

runners_data.name: Dabbling
runners_data.note: Front runner with 211 days off but has shown early pace in all starts, biggest fitness concern
runners_data.comment: 2-1 for handicap debut but finished last of nine and was found to have bled; off since
runners_data.spotlight: On the back of quite promising efforts on her first three starts she was backed into 2-1 favouritism for her Carlisle handicap debut in September but finished last of nine and was subsequently found to have bled; off since; it'll be interesting to see whether her supporters are prepared to give her another chance.

runners_data.name: Rotokura Belle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won over course and distance, AW form disappointing but turf return key
runners_data.comment: Cosy winner at Southwell last autumn but below that level in three subsequent AW starts
runners_data.spotlight: Cosy winner over 5f at Southwell last September but hasn't come come close to reproducing that in three subsequent AW starts; it remains to be seen whether a return to turf sparks a revival.

runners_data.name: O Fortuna
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from strong yard, 212 days off but related to smart sprinter, handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Potential improver in handicaps for yard with good recent record in this; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: No more than hinted at ability in three outings last year but this half-brother to the smart sprinter Adresita rates a potential improver now moving into handicap company for a yard which has won the last two runnings of this race; has been gelded; interesting, particularly if backed.

runners_data.name: Regal Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent 5f form on good ground, well-backed favourite last time suggests ability
runners_data.comment: Only fourth on nursery debut in October but was 13-8 favourite; first run since
runners_data.spotlight: Could only manage fourth of eight on her 5f Redcar handicap debut (good) in October but the fact she went off the 13-8 favourite suggests better was anticipated; remains unexposed and it'll be interesting to see if there's money for her again back from six months off.

runners_data.name: Brave Traveller
runners_data.note: Front runner in good form, faded on reappearance but entitled to improve for recent run
runners_data.comment: 6f Newcastle win in December; possibly just needed recent reappearance there; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Edged out Liverpool Star to win a 6f Newcastle handicap in December; faded into fifth on his reappearance there in March but is entitled to strip fitter for the outing; showed promise on turf at the start of his career; respected.

runners_data.name: Liverpool Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who narrowly lost to Brave Traveller off same mark, strong AW form
runners_data.comment: In fair form on AW ahead of this return to turf; ought to be thereabouts
runners_data.spotlight: Edged out by Brave Traveller at Newcastle (6f) off this mark in December and respectable efforts in three subsequent AW outings; should be competitive back on turf.

runners_data.name: Empress Olivia
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping back to optimum 5f trip after struggling at 7f last time
runners_data.comment: 6f turf maiden winner but fourth is the best she managed in three handicaps last year
runners_data.spotlight: Won Ripon maiden (6f, good) last summer; respectable efforts in her first two handicaps (both 6f turf) but well held over 7f on AW final start; drops back to the minimum trip on her return from five months off; others are more obvious.

runners_data.name: Moretons
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with claiming jockey, inconsistent form but showed ability for previous yard
runners_data.comment: Close second at Wolverhampton in October but well beaten since, including yard debut
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort for George Scott when beaten a neck in Wolverhampton handicap (5f, AW) in October but hasn't come close to backing it up in three outings since, including yard debut 34 days ago; plenty to prove for now.

runners_data.name: Jack Rabbit Slims
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 196 days off, showed promise but disappointing in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Odd bit of promise last year but well held in both handicaps; been off for 196 days
runners_data.spotlight: Showed the odd bit of promise last year but finished down the field in his two handicaps; back from six months off with his yard in reasonable form.

runners_data.name: Contorno
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who justified strong support at Newcastle, form behind Liverpool Star gives hope
runners_data.comment: 2-3 in AW handicaps; edged out a next-time-out winner latest so 2lb nudge may not stop him
runners_data.spotlight: Justified strong market support on his 5f Newcastle handicap debut in January; finished behind the reopposing Liverpool Star at Southwell next time but resumed his progression when landing another 5f Newcastle handicap last month; edged out a next-time-out winner on that occasion so should still be feasibly treated after a 2lb nudge.

races.paceDynamic: Dabbling, Brave Traveller and Jack Rabbit Slims will ensure a strong gallop from the flag, with four more wanting prominent spots creating early congestion. The pace will be honest throughout this 5f dash, testing stamina reserves in the final furlong. With seven of ten runners wanting to race handy, those able to settle and produce late kicks will have a significant tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like O Fortuna and Liverpool Star who can exploit the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too hard early and the prominent brigade gets sucked in
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will take its toll in the final furlong, allowing patient riders to pick off tired leaders. Hold-up horses with turn of foot will have clear runs as the field spreads out.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Survive
scenarios.trigger: If Dabbling or Brave Traveller can dictate at a controlled pace
scenarios.body: One of the leaders will have enough left to repel late challengers, especially if they can steal a march turning for home. The winner comes from those who can lead without being headed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but one prominent runner avoids the early scrimmaging
scenarios.body: A horse like Regal Dream or Empress Olivia tracks the pace without getting involved in the congestion and times their run perfectly. They benefit from the strong pace without contributing to it.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is stop-start due to early positioning battles
scenarios.body: The tactical nature allows an unfancied runner to get into contention when the race doesn't unfold as expected. A horse previously struggling for form finds improvement in the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Dabbling and Jack Rabbit Slims both return from long layoffs as confirmed pace-setters, fitness a major concern
Traffic problems likely at the 2f pole with Rotokura Belle, Regal Dream, Empress Olivia and Moretons all wanting prominent spots
Liverpool Star and O Fortuna both from Easterby yards with poor recent strike rates but hold-up styles suit this pace
Brave Traveller faded badly on reappearance and may struggle if forced into another speed duel
Contorno's recent Newcastle win came off strong market support, suggesting connections expect more improvement

races.paceDynamic: Jeddaal will dictate from the front with North Force and The Floors Munky providing early company in the prominent positions. This creates a moderate tempo rather than breakneck speed, as Jeddaal has shown he can sustain his efforts when not pressured early. The large hold-up contingent including Red Spells Danger, Decem Starr, Hatamoto and Hansteen will look to pounce late, but the steady gallop may not provide enough pace collapse. This shape favours the front-running and prominent runners who can establish good positions without excessive energy expenditure early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Jeddaal sets sensible fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his kick for home while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the steady pace. North Force and other prominent runners get first run on those still shuffling for racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup as the race becomes a sprint from 2f out. Red Spells Danger and Decem Starr benefit from their patient tactics when the race develops into their preferred pattern.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced runners possess untapped ability
scenarios.body: Forest Phoenix or Talking In Kode show significant improvement from their homework. Their unknown quantities prove superior to the exposed moderate form of the more experienced runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Jeddaal goes too fast early under pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The front-runners tie up dramatically in the final furlong after unsustainable fractions. This creates the perfect scenario for the most patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders.

watchPoints.text: Jeddaal could steal this if allowed an easy lead as he has the tactical advantage and proven form at the trip
North Force showed real promise when placed twice last season and drops back to his optimum 7f distance
Forest Phoenix and Talking In Kode are complete unknowns whose homework could reveal significant ability
Red Spells Danger has the form to win this but Tim Easterby's 0-17 recent record raises serious concerns
The consistent good going throughout the card suggests conditions will remain fair for all runners

races.name: Bet At Racing TV Handicap

runners_data.name: Dr Rio
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who loves Beverley but faces 203-day absence and unfamiliar track
runners_data.comment: Beverley specialist; now ten and lacks a recent run; hasn't shone here previously
runners_data.spotlight: All six of his wins in Britain, and all ten of his outings last season, have come at Beverley; won over 7.4f/1m4f last summer but this 10yo lacks a recent outing and hasn't really shone on his three previous visits here.

runners_data.name: Farandaway
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner fresh from maiden breakthrough but lacks experience in handicaps
runners_data.comment: In good form over 5f/6f on AW and in the mix if seeing out this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Running well in defeat in 5f/6f handicaps on AW prior to getting off the mark at the 17th attempt in Newcastle maiden (6f, AW) three weeks ago; positive performances on all three previous visits here; untested at 7f but it's possible the trip will be within range; in the mix if seeing it out.

runners_data.name: Way To Dubai
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who won over this trip in January but slow starts hurt his chances
runners_data.comment: Poor strike-rate in Britain but has managed a win this year and might not be far away
runners_data.spotlight: He's won just once since making his British debut in October 2023; however, that came this January (7f, AW) and a slow start proved costly when back at 6f at Southwell last Thursday; effective on turf and might not be far away now back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Vince Le Prince
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong C&D form who typically runs well fresh after breaks
runners_data.comment: 0-16 last year but runner-up four times and he goes well fresh; could be bang there
runners_data.spotlight: 0-16 last year but runner-up four times, including over C&D last October when last seen; he's run well on his reappearance in each of the last two seasons and this three-time C&D winner could be bang there.

runners_data.name: Yafaarr
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs the gaps to appear but has solid 7f form

runners_data.name: Hostility
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on dangerous low mark after poor end to last season
runners_data.comment: Below best towards end of last year and 0-13, but he's dropped to a dangerous mark
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden who wasn't at his best towards the end of last year; however, he's dropped to a dangerous mark and it will be no surprise if he's in the shake-up on this reappearance, for which he wears a first-time visor.

runners_data.name: Tarlac
runners_data.note: Prominent type who's 6lb lower than last win but may have needed recent comeback
runners_data.comment: 6lb below last May's last winning mark but there was no return to form on recent comeback
runners_data.spotlight: He's 6lb lower than when winning at Ripon (6f, good to soft) last May and he may have needed his recent comeback run at Newcastle; however, he was also below his best on his final few starts last term and 6f may suit best.

runners_data.name: Highfield Sunshine
runners_data.note: Prominent racer wearing first-time hood after disappointing finish to 2024
runners_data.comment: 12-race maiden but on a handy mark on last season's best form, including over C&D
runners_data.spotlight: Below best at the end of last season and she's 0-12; wears a first-time hood for this return, having worn blinkers then cheekpieces on final two runs last term; on a handy mark on last season's best efforts (including over C&D) and she's not discounted.

runners_data.name: Coconut Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong C&D record but lost form badly last autumn
runners_data.comment: She lost her form last autumn but a break may have helped; two C&D wins last summer
runners_data.spotlight: She lost her form last autumn but won four times during a busy 2025, two of them over C&D (good/good to firm), and a break may have helped; she's 3lb below her last winning mark and could have a big say.

runners_data.name: Roundhay Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist better at 6f and facing 7f for first time in ages
runners_data.comment: Won at Ripon last July when 2lb lower; 6f seems to be this 11yo's optimum trip nowadays
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner who scored at Ripon (6f, soft) last July and is just 2lb higher on this reappearance outing; however, 6f has been this 11yo's optimum trip in recent seasons, and this is his first run since October.

runners_data.name: Evocative Spark
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with apprentice jockey who lacks tactical speed for this trip

runners_data.name: Crocodile Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose best form comes on softer ground than today's good
runners_data.comment: His last four wins have come here, but over 6f, and soft ground appears to be preferable
runners_data.spotlight: His last four wins have come over 6f here; can't be ruled out given his record here and one of those wins came on good ground, but soft going appears to bring out the best in him and 6f looks to be his optimum trip; races for the first-time since December.

runners_data.name: Precious Spartan
runners_data.note: Hold-up type stepping back down in trip after 201-day break
runners_data.comment: Progressive after joining this yard last May and he's one to consider on his reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive after joining this yard last May, winning three times at Ripon (1m, good) and posting a close third at Ayr (1m, soft) in September when last seen; the drop back to 7f might not be ideal on his reappearance but he's one to consider nevertheless.

runners_data.name: Wadacre Maestro
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner who should get uncontested lead but lacks consistency
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent last year but won in August and remains lightly raced; could be a contender
runners_data.spotlight: Inconsistent last year but won at Musselburgh (7f, good) in August on his third handicap start and wasn't beaten far in fifth at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) when last seen; remains lightly raced and could be a contender.

races.paceDynamic: Wadacre Maestro is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with minimal early pressure. The prominent horses like Vince Le Prince, Hostility, Tarlac and Highfield Sunshine will settle just behind, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Dr Rio, Farandaway, Way To Dubai and Yafaarr will track from midfield and back. With such a sustainable pace likely, this race strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Wadacre Maestro jumps cleanly and gets first run without pressure...
scenarios.body: The Charlie Johnston runner controls the tempo and kicks clear in the straight with the prominent horses chasing but unable to peg him back. The sustainable gallop suits the pace-setters perfectly over this 7f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Vince Le Prince or Hostility track the leader perfectly and time their challenge...
scenarios.body: One of the experienced prominent runners uses their tactical speed to collar Wadacre Maestro in the final furlong when the leader's stamina gives way. The good ground suits their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the hold-up horses get the perfect setup...
scenarios.body: Farandaway or Way To Dubai benefit from a crawling gallop that turns into a sprint finish, using their superior finishing speed. The tactical pace allows them to overcome their poor positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Course Specialist
scenarios.trigger: If Dr Rio overcomes his 203-day absence and the pace collapses completely...
scenarios.body: The Beverley specialist finds this track similar enough to his favourite venue and his hold-up style benefits from a messy tactical affair. His experience in these situations proves decisive despite the long layoff.

watchPoints.text: Wadacre Maestro must jump alertly to secure the early lead as any hesitation allows prominent runners to press him
Vince Le Prince typically runs well fresh and his C&D form makes him the biggest threat to the leader
Dr Rio's 203-day absence is massive but his Beverley record suggests he retains ability if the pace suits
Farandaway's inexperience in handicaps could be exposed despite his recent maiden success
The good going may not suit several runners who show better form on softer surfaces

runners_data.spotlight: Now 1lb lower than when winning over 1m at Carlisle last May, and there have been a couple of good runs over 1m on AW since; however, she was below par last month and it's a long time since she ran over a trip this far; arrives with something to prove.

runners_data.spotlight: Didn't run badly when sixth of ten at Wolverhampton (1m6f, AW) two starts ago but well beaten since and now 0-16; others are preferred.

runners_data.spotlight: Won at Newcastle (1m4f, AW) last October and close fourth there (1m4f, AW) in February; didn't see out 2m there last month; also effective on turf and she's one to consider now back down in trip.

races.paceDynamic: V Twelve is the only confirmed front runner and will lead uncontested through reasonable fractions on good ground over this staying trip. Behind him, Ebony Maw, Wheres The Crumpet, Nakatomi and Free Pic will create a packed prominent group, leading to inevitable traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up horses Stellarmasterpiece, Kitsune Power, Tupero and It's Only Fun will have their work cut out getting clear runs through the congestion. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader V Twelve, as he can dictate terms without pressure and kick clear before the prominent pack sorts itself out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve gets his own way in front and the prominent group gets snarled up
scenarios.body: V Twelve sets honest fractions without pressure then quickens approaching the final furlong as the traffic-bound pack struggles for room. His summer form off this mark at Hamilton proves he can capitalize when getting an easy lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Overcomes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough and one hold-up horse finds the perfect passage through
scenarios.body: Stellarmasterpiece or Kitsune Power times their run to perfection, weaving through the prominent congestion to strike late. The sustained gallop over this trip plays to their patient tactics when they get a clear sight of goal.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Escapes Early
scenarios.trigger: If one from the packed second rank breaks clear before the home turn
scenarios.body: Wheres The Crumpet or Free Pic anticipates the traffic jam and moves forward early, getting first run on the field. Their tactical speed allows them to build an unassailable lead while the others are still finding racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve stops and the prominent group comes to a standstill
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Tupero's recent AW form and tactical pace prove decisive against a slowly-run contest. The lack of genuine pace throughout allows his class to show in the final 100 yards.

watchPoints.text: V Twelve breaking clear approaching two furlongs out while the prominent pack behind him gets bottled up
Stellarmasterpiece and Kitsune Power getting squeezed for room in the home straight as the field bunches
Wheres The Crumpet and Free Pic making forward moves too early and getting swallowed up late
Tupero finding traffic problems at the business end despite his recent winning form
The prominent quartet of Ebony Maw, Wheres The Crumpet, Nakatomi and Free Pic creating a wall across the track

races.paceDynamic: Roland Garros will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a manageable pace with no obvious pressure from early in this weak 9-runner handicap. The rest are predominantly hold-up horses who will settle behind and look to finish, creating a bunched field entering the straight. With 8 of 9 runners showing hold-up tendencies and only one natural leader, this sets up as a tactical affair where the pace will likely be steady early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with a strong finishing kick, as they'll get the run of the race behind an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros sets a steady pace and the hold-up brigade get organized
scenarios.body: The large pack of closers will have ideal conditions to mount their challenge in the straight, overwhelming the lone leader who may have done too much. Gastronomy and Naturalia, both proven at this trip with strong finishing kicks, are perfectly positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Weak Field
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros gets easy fractions and finds extra when challenged
scenarios.body: With such a weak field behind him and no early pressure, the leader could skip clear turning for home and prove hard to catch despite his maiden status. His recent hurdles form suggests stamina for the trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Benefits Improver
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a crawl with the hold-up horses marking each other
scenarios.body: A slow-run race could turn into a sprint finish where class tells, potentially suiting an improver like Eagles Whistle who has winning form. The tactical nature could catch out some of the longer-absent runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long-Absent Runner Returns Fresh
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lengthy absentees like Gastronomy or Naturalia shows dramatic improvement
scenarios.body: After breathing surgery or extended breaks, either could return significantly better than recent form suggests. However, both face fitness questions after lengthy layoffs.

watchPoints.text: Watch Roland Garros early - if he gets too keen or meets early pressure, his chances diminish significantly in this tactical race
Monitor Gastronomy's breathing and early position - if the surgery worked he could be dramatically better than recent form suggests
Check how Hickton travels in the early stages given his bleeding episode on reappearance last time out
Observe if any of the hold-up horses position closer than usual to take advantage of the likely steady pace
Watch for market support for Naturalia given her lengthy absence but proven ability at this grade on turf

races.paceDynamic: Valley Ofthe Kings will lead uncontested with Kats Bob likely settling just off the pace, creating a moderate tempo in the early stages. With only one confirmed front-runner and several prominent runners (Aberama Gold, Miraculous, Sir Garfield) sitting handy, the pace will be sustainable rather than punishing. The lack of early speed pressure means Valley Ofthe Kings can dictate fractions before the field bunches up in the final two furlongs. This controlled tempo strongly favours hold-up horses like Trilby, Francisco's Piece, The Good Biscuit and Secret Guest who can finish powerfully off the steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Valley Ofthe Kings sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: The sustainable tempo allows closers to wind up powerfully in the final furlong as the early leaders tire. Hold-up runners like Trilby and Secret Guest can unleash their finishing kicks to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Aberama Gold and Miraculous track the leader closely and kick clear mid-race
scenarios.body: The experienced prominent runners use their tactical speed to build a decisive advantage before the hold-up horses can respond. Their proximity to the pace proves crucial when the real running begins.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front End Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Valley Ofthe Kings goes too fast early under pressure from multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The increased tempo burns out the early leaders completely, allowing a patient ride on a hold-up horse to sweep past tired rivals. The Good Biscuit or Francisco's Piece capitalise on the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Special
scenarios.trigger: If Valley Ofthe Kings gets soft fractions and Jack Dace times his kick perfectly
scenarios.body: The leader conserves energy beautifully and has enough left to repel all challengers in a gutsy front-running performance. Kats Bob might chase him home if tracking closely throughout.

watchPoints.text: Valley Ofthe Kings could get away with stealing a march if he jumps alertly and the field is slow to respond early
Francisco's Piece carrying 135lbs after a long layoff may struggle to quicken when the pace lifts
Miraculous returning after 172 days might need the run despite his obvious class advantage
The Good Biscuit's recent Southwell wins on soft ground translate well to this good turf conditions
Trilby's hold-up style is perfectly suited if the pace stays modest as expected throughout

races.paceDynamic: Miss Rainbow will set the pace with minimal early pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner in this 9-runner field. Keldeo and Filly's Last Lady should press forward into prominent positions, but the majority of the field (One Of Our Own, White Umbrella, Paroda Diva, Fizzy Cristal, Moostar, Indy's Angel) are hold-up horses who will settle towards the rear. This creates a sustainable gallop that builds gradually, with Miss Rainbow likely unchallenged through the early stages before the field closes from halfway. The lack of early pace pressure and abundance of hold-up horses strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can establish good positions without excessive early effort.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Rainbow gets an easy lead and maintains her gallop to the line
scenarios.body: The pace-setter faces minimal early pressure and can dictate terms throughout, with the hold-up horses leaving themselves too much to do in the closing stages. Her course form and recent sharpener give her every chance to exploit the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Presser Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Keldeo or Filly's Last Lady can sit handy and outkick the leader
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get the perfect trip behind Miss Rainbow's steady gallop and have enough left to challenge strongly in the final furlong. Their tactical position proves superior to both the uncontested leader and the deep-closing hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Flies Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and the field spreads out dramatically
scenarios.body: The early leaders go too hard despite the lack of pressure, allowing the best of the hold-up horses to close strongly from off the pace. Moostar or Fizzy Cristal benefit from their recent good form and the extra time to gather momentum.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites disappoint and a lesser-fancied runner finds unexpected improvement
scenarios.body: The established form horses fail to deliver, allowing one of the bigger prices to take advantage of the tactical setup. The sustainable pace suits a horse returning from a break or stepping up significantly.

watchPoints.text: Miss Rainbow could steal this if allowed uncontested lead - watch for how much rope the jockeys give the only pace-setter
Keldeo and Filly's Last Lady positioning crucial early - if both sit too close to Miss Rainbow they could compromise each other
Moostar and Fizzy Cristal both hold strong recent form - monitor their early positioning to gauge whether they get the trip they need
One Of Our Own carries topweight returning from 155 days off with historically poor fresh record - market support would be significant
Field lacks genuine early pace beyond Miss Rainbow - watch for any surprise tactics from the hold-up brigade trying to get closer
